8.3.19 FrNm_SetSleepReadyBit
[SWS_FrNm_91001] Definition of API function FrNm_SetSleepReadyBit ⌈
Service Name
FrNm_SetSleepReadyBit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType FrNm_SetSleepReadyBit (
NetworkHandleType nmChannelHandle,
boolean nmSleepReadyBit
)
Service ID [hex]
0x12
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
nmChannelHandle
Identification of the NM-channel
Parameters (in)
nmSleepReadyBit
Value written to ReadySleep Bit in CBV
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: No error
E_NOT_OK: Writing of remote sleep indication bit has failed
Description
Set the NM Coordinator Sleep Ready bit in the Control Bit Vector
Available via
FrNm.h
⌋
